featured_reviews.name: Uday Ambike
featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked the 5D-4N tour from Rajguru Tours. They have done the flight bookings as well as the resort booking. They have arranged Innova for us to travel from airport, to visit different places in Coorg and for travelling back to airport as well.
We were accomodated at the Porcupine Castle Resort Coorg.
We were picked up at the Bangalore airport on time by our driver Chandru, for the next five days.
While going to Coorg we visited Vishnu and Laxmi Temple in Srirangapatna. The temple is very nice. And then Tipu Sultan Palace.
We were brought to our resort. The Porcupine Castle Resort is wonderful. Rajguru Tours booked two rooms with Mountain View for us. The view was very nice. Food quality was very delicious and excellent. Hotel staff are very polite.
Next day we went to Raja Seat were we captured multiple photos. Then we went for coffee plantation tour were guide explained us about different types of trees, coffees, spices. There we bought some spices and homemade chocolates. After that we went to Government Museum Madikeri. The museum has different types of statues and also armours which was used in ancient times. Then we went to Abbi Falls. The view is very beautiful 😍 After Abbi Falls we came back to our resort. And we had our dinner.
On the next day we went to Golden Temple and Tibetean Monestry. I must say it's worth to visit when you are in Coorg.
After visiting the Golden Temple and Tibetean Monestry we went to Nisargadhama. There we visited the Nisargadhama Bird Park. In the bird park there are different types of birds available. And even there is a place to feed the birds.
Then we went to Dubare Elephant Camp. The elephant camp is must visit place. There are around 27 elephants. To visit that camp you need to travel by boat and the ticket booking for the same starts at 4.00 PM.
After completing the Dubare Elephant Camp we came back to resort and we had our dinner.
Next day we relaxed at the resort.
And on the last day we started our journey back from Coorg to Bangalore airport.
The service of Rajguru Tours was spotless! Specially Mrs. Trupti Ma'am s co-ordination with us from start to end was excellent. She took utmost care of us.
Thank You Very Much Trupti Ma'am and Rajguru Tours for your wonderful services.😊😊
